post.description: Persists paper plus typed metadata for none, polaroid, coupon, ghost-stamp, or prescription content

get.description: Claims one queued job only while the printer is online, paperStatus is ok, the cover is closed, and no printer error exists; otherwise returns 204 without changing the job

post.description: Use /complete, /fail, or /retry suffixes; /fail accepts error and retryable (default true); interrupted raster frames must use retryable false; invalid transitions return 409

get.description: Device status includes statusSource and statusReason; missing or expired heartbeats are explicit, printer fields are null when disabled and paperStatus is unknown when online but unreported

post.description: Direct heartbeat for macmini, esp32, printer, and powerBank; E-ink returns 409 EINK_HEARTBEAT_NOT_SUPPORTED

patch.description: Sets a sticky manual out/near_end paper lock or clears it with null after paper is loaded; hardware heartbeats cannot overwrite an active lock

get.description: ETag/If-None-Match; 304 means no refresh; batteryPct is null when unknown
Uses the same device status semantics as E-ink state

x-boundary: Calendar defaults to Mock and Google remains disabled without credentials. ESP32 heartbeat, E-ink state, and raster print queue are live LAN contracts; no public deployment.
